hero.eyebrow: A bed and breakfast in Aiken, South Carolina
hero.title: Aiken’s *best-kept secret*
hero.lede: Two rooms and a private suite in a historic Southern home, with a gourmet breakfast, an evening wine and charcuterie hour, and a saltwater pool. A short trip to downtown Aiken, and a home base for the Masters.

image.alt: The farm’s white Southern home with a columned portico, palm trees and a gravel drive

items.title: Deluxe King Room
items.text: From $225. A king panel bed, a sitting area in the light of grand windows, double closets, a 50″ smart TV and a Nespresso machine. Its own bathroom next door, with a standalone tub and walk-in shower, opens with a private code.

items.title: Deluxe Queen Room
items.text: A queen panel bed, an en-suite bath with tub and shower, a walk-in closet, a dedicated workspace, a 43″ smart TV and a mini fridge stocked with water and soda.

items.title: Deluxe Private Double Suite
items.text: From $595. Three rooms: a four-poster king, an adjoining queen room and a private sitting area with a large trundle bed. Walk-in shower, double vanity and a 55″ gallery TV.

items.text: WOW! What a hidden gem! … It turned out to be one of the best travel experiences we’ve had! No stone was left unturned.
When I say they thought of everything to make your stay enjoyable, I mean everything.
The patio and pool was the perfect way to end the night with a drink and a great charcuterie board. Then to wake up with a home cooked breakfast and a coffee was even more Amazing.

items.q: Are the rooms on the ground floor?
items.a: All of our guest rooms are on the second floor of the home.

items.q: Is the suite good for a group?
items.a: Yes. The Private Double Suite has a king, a queen and a large trundle bed across three rooms, ideal for couples or small groups.
